messages:
lina (partner-ops): Quick heads-up — NimbusCloud joint launch on Tue. Need to lock partner SEV escalation flow. Current issues: unclear shared channel, who does handoff, what log/data can be shared. Can we agree today?
ashley (partnerships): +1. I think a single shared war-room channel works for visibility. Primary Redwood liaison: @sam, secondary: @dmitri. We should also define naming and a short handoff checklist.
sam (oncall): I'm fine being primary. Proposed minimal runbook steps:
1) Create private war-room channel
2) Post safe summary + redacted logs link
3) Run initial triage (owner, ETA)
4) Page oncall if sev >= 2
5) Escalate to partner liaisons if no progress in 30m
Channel name pattern suggestion:
```
#war-partner-nimbus-<INC-ID>
```
and command to create:
```
create-channel --private --name war-partner-nimbus-INC123 --purpose "Partner SEV: Nimbus" --members @sam @dmitri @lina
```
dmitri (eng-sre): Agree. Two additional rules:
- Never paste raw customer PII or unredacted logs into the shared channel
- Use redacted log bundles and short-lived S3 links restricted by IAM
Example S3 copy (redaction done upstream):
```
aws s3 cp /tmp/redacted-logs s3://redwood-partner-share/INC123/ --acl private
```
ashley (partnerships): Also add a billing/sales notify step for any incident that may impact SLAs or run longer than 2 hours. Tag: #sales-oncall and add the customer success contact.
pagerbot (bot): Incident INC-2026-04-05-123 created by sam. Severity: 2. War room channel suggested: #war-partner-nimbus-INC123
lina (partner-ops): This looks good. Can someone draft a one-page partner-handoff template? Also need a short consent blurb for Nimbus around data redaction rules.
sam (oncall): I'll draft the template now. Handoff template (paste into channel):
```
Handoff: INC123 | Severity: 2 | Owner: @sam
Summary: <2-line summary>
Actions taken: <list>
Open blockers: <list>
Redacted logs: <s3 link>
ETA next update: <15m>
Partner liaisons: <names/contacts>
```
dmitri (eng-sre): Add timeline markers (T+0, T+30) and link to audit logs in the template: `Audit: /console/audit?inc=INC123`
ashley (partnerships): I'll coordinate with Nimbus to confirm their oncall aliases and add them to the channel before launch. Also propose a weekly 15m drill for the first month post-launch.
lina (partner-ops): Perfect. Can we all react with :thumbsup: if you ack and sam can share the draft doc in #partners-docs? I'll create the channel and add the template to the onboarding doc.
sam (oncall): :thumbsup: will post the draft and follow up with a tiny SOP doc.
ashley (partnerships): :thumbsup:
dmitri (eng-sre): :thumbsup:
pagerbot (bot): Reminder scheduled: partner-sev-drill on 2026-04-08 10:00 UTC
lina (partner-ops): Closing this thread — thanks everyone. I'll send calendar invites and the onboarding snippet.
